english.title: Member of public import / acquire / possess / use a regulated substance without licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a member of the public,

(A)_[imported]_
(B)_[acquired]_
(C)_[possessed]_
(D)_[used]_

a regulated substance namely **(..SPECIFY REGULATED SUBSTANCE..)

without having a licence, or a recognised non-GB licence, to do that thing with respect to that substance
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1) and 8(1) of the Poisons Act 1972.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a member of the public
imported / acquired / possessed / used a regulated substance
without having a licence or a recognised non-GB licence to do that thing with respect to that substance

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 2 of the Poisons Act 1972 for the meaning of regulated substance.
(ii) See section 3(3) for the meanings of importing, acquiring, member of the public, possessing and using.
(iii) Section 3(4) provides that a member of the public does not commit an offence under subsection (1) if the requirements of this section do not apply to his or her case by virtue of regulations made under section 9B.
(iv) This offence does not apply to the possession or use of a regulated substance at any time before 3 March 2016.
(v) See section section 7A which gives the defence of proof of lack of knowledge.

(A)_[fewnforio]_
(B)_[gaffael]_
(C)_[feddu ar]_
(D)_[ddefnyddio]_

heb drwydded, neu drwydded nad yw'n un DU cydnabyddedig , i wneud hynny yng nghyswllt y sylwedd hwnnw
